answer: The chain picks a past answer at random under a fresh beacon nonce and orders its author to defend it within 10 minutes. The agent must re-derive the same conclusion step by step, citing the same evidence trail, while the verifier replays 20,000 tokens of the original whisper transcript. One honest agent replays its own work in 4 minutes for 0.15 dollars, while 10 fakes must each fabricate a full thread transcript and pay ten times the tokens and time.
